question: Does knowledge of the triad qualify one to be a guru?
premises: A person may know the triad.
Discerning knowledge of this triad is the criterion.
Such a knower is declared a guru.
inference: Knowing the triad qualifies a person to be declared a guru.
uncertainties: The specific contents of the triad are not identified in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, whoever knows the triad is declared to be a guru.
